result.title: From legal bottleneck to business partner | Legora’s Emma Kadri Bergström
result.description:
NDA reviews once took up around 20% of Legora’s legal team’s capacity. Today, that figure is under 1%. General Counsel Emma Kadri Bergström shares how AI is helping her team reclaim time, support a rapidly growing business and take on more complex work, while keeping lawyers responsible for the decisions. Part of Intelligence at Work. 

Read the full story: https://openai.com/index/legora-agentic-operating-system-for-legal-work/

result.title: Building the future of legal work with AI | Legora CEO Max Junestrand
result.description:
Legora co-founder and CEO Max Junestrand wants to make legal expertise available wherever it’s needed. He shares how OpenAI helped turn that ambition into a platform, why staying AI-native matters as the company grows, and what becomes possible when lawyers can take on work that time and capacity once put out of reach. Part of Intelligence at Work.

result.title: Faster contract review. Broader legal analysis. | Legora’s Alex Fortescue-Webb
result.description:
When deadlines limit how many contracts lawyers can examine, important risks can go unseen. Alex Fortescue-Webb, Global Head of Legal Engineering at Legora, explains how AI powered by OpenAI models helps teams analyse thousands of contracts across multiple questions in minutes, expanding the scope of due diligence and giving lawyers more information to apply their judgment. Part of Intelligence at Work.
